run_WM_Planning_Evaluator: run the WM_Planning_Evaluator to evaluate navigation planning on datasets using CEM optimization and LPIPS loss
run_generate_actions: run generate_actions to produce planned trajectory actions using cross-entropy method optimization over rollout predictions
run_autoregressive_rollout: run autoregressive_rollout to iteratively predict future observations given an observation sequence and action deltas
run_eval_metrics: run eval_metrics to compute ATE and RPE trajectory error metrics between ground truth and predicted trajectories
run_plot_batch_final: run plot_batch_final to create a visualization grid of initial, predicted, and goal images with loss overlays
